items.heading: Rank Skills By the Room
items.text: Rank skills by the room above the beginner rate, not by how many people are hiring. A skill that pays Rs 3,000 an hour at the top needs fewer hours to reach lakhs than one that stops near Rs 800.

items.heading: There Is No Official Average
items.text: There is no official average income for freelancers in India. The Economic Survey 2025-26 counts about 1.2 crore gig and platform workers, and press coverage says around 40% of them earn below Rs 15,000 a month, but that figure is not in the government's own release. The biggest concentration of that work is in e-commerce and logistics, so it is a weak guide to skilled freelancing.

items.heading: Divide the Target By Your
items.text: Divide the target by your hourly rate and you get the hours you must bill, meaning hours a client pays for, to reach Rs 1 lakh.
